# Third-party files

These are bundled unmodified so Skylog works offline.

| File | Project | License |
|---|---|---|
| `d3.min.js` | [D3](https://d3js.org) v7.9.0 | ISC |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | [topojson-client](https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client) v3.1.0 | ISC |
| `countries-110m.json`, `countries-50m.json` | [world-atlas](https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas) v2.0.2, derived from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com) | ISC; Natural Earth data is public domain |
| `alliance-logos/star-alliance.svg` | [Logo Star Alliance cropped.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Logo_Star_Alliance_cropped.svg), Wikimedia Commons | Public domain (simple geometry); Star Alliance trademark |
| `alliance-logos/skyteam.svg` | Cropped from [Skyteam logo.png](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Skyteam_logo.png), Wikimedia Commons | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); SkyTeam trademark |
| `alliance-logos/oneworld.svg` | [Oneworld logo (flat).svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Oneworld_logo_(flat).svg), Wikimedia Commons | Public domain (simple text and shape); oneworld trademark |
| `cities.json` | Trimmed from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com) 1:50m populated places (name, coordinates, min zoom, population) | Public domain |
